author: raxhvl
content:
Re: 5770 vs. 5820

<@573787335796326400> asked whether implementing 5770 now and 5820 later could be a compromise to avoid delaying Glam over 5820. 

Since Teku already has RLP, I put together a prototype to check feasibility, especially behavior around the fork boundary.

The approach seems feasible, with the tradeoff of adding permanent RLP bloat to the CL. This is just an initial feasibility check ahead todays ACDC not a recommendation either way or a final verdict. I may be missing things, so feedback is very welcome. The prototype PR description lays out the assumptions; reviewing those would be the best way to weigh in.

https://github.com/raxhvl/teku/pull/1

h/t <@504202741933932544> for the initial discussion
